title: Instructor
description: The `instructor` global (_data/instructor.json): the instructor's name, office location, contact information, and office hours that Meredith College requires on every syllabus. Rendered by the `<instructor>` component. The kit encodes `email` so the address never appears in served markup; a script decodes it for the reader. Property order here is the suggested authoring order.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, for editor validation.

name.description: Full name as it should appear on the syllabus.

office.description: Office location — building and room (e.g. SMB 251). Meredith requires it on the syllabus.

hours.description: Office hours as displayed, one entry per block; "by appointment" is a valid single entry. Meredith requires office hours on the syllabus. Joined with semicolons in the template.

email.description: Plain address; write it normally. The kit encodes it at build time and a script fills in the link for the reader. The printed syllabus shows it.

profile.description: Optional public profile the name links to.

blog.description: Optional personal site or blog, shown as its own row in the instructor panel.

photo.description: Optional headshot, a site-relative path under /images/ (the file lives in content/assets/images/). Shown on screen beside the instructor details; omitted from print, where the instructor collapses to one line.

note.description: Response-time expectation, rendered muted after the contact details.

contact.description: Site-relative path of the contact page, shown on screen in place of the address.
